rows.en: What's the situation!?
The Gulfer Machine Beasts have breached the Federation Space Force's final defense line.
What happened to GEAR's combat satellites!?
Their operational capacity is down to 13%! We can't stop the enemy's advance!
Grr...! Those bastards broke through our defenses so easily!
The Earth Federation Army's air squadron has entered the first phase of its attack.
I only hope they can somehow hold them off...!
Chief, I believe the enemy is targeting our underground research laboratory here.
I suggest we contact the Federation government immediately and request permission to use it.
rows.notes: The deliberately unnamed object remains it; no identity is added.

rows.en: Yes. In the meantime, you must start preparations. We'll launch Operation D as soon as permission is granted.
rows.notes: Operation D is source-literal and unexpanded. Root accepted it centrally; no relevant canonical Akurasu MX entry was found.
uncertain: No canonical sourced English label was established for Operation D; the literal label is accepted centrally.

rows.en: Understood.
Aiko, contact Vega immediately.
Roger!
Kirakuni, the time has finally come. I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Shibuya asks Kirakuni to act: request direction is I am counting on you.

rows.en: Yes, sir! You can leave it to me, Susumu Kirakuni!
Aiko, where is the Nahel Argama squad that Commander Misumaru told us about?
They're on patrol near Point U1123. They're in a position to reach us in 32 minutes.
Then send them a request for support.
Well, Hokuto? Do you like Hoshimi Town?
I don't know yet. We only moved here today. What about you, Mom?
I think it's a nice town. The people here seem friendly, too...
And I'm all fired up to open the cafe tomorrow!
Don't work so hard you hurt yourself. You're pretty clumsy, Mom.
You've got some nerve, Hokuto.
rows.notes: Playful reply to Hokuto calling his mother clumsy.

rows.en: But I'm sure you'll make some good friends soon, and you'll come to love this town.
I hope so.
Hokuto, is there anywhere else you'd like to go?
There is, but... I have to help unpack.
Let's leave the rest until Keisuke gets home from work... and go have a look around town.
Then I'd... like to see the school.
Of course... You'll be going there starting tomorrow.
Hah! Hmph! Hyaaah!!
Mom beat me again yesterday...! But today, I'm gonna win!
And I'm gonna become an awesome martial artist, just like Kazuya Ryuzaki and the King of Hearts!
rows.notes: Thought; both martial-artist examples retained with glossary names.

rows.en: Hah! Hi-yah! Daaah!

rows.notes: Source silence retained.

rows.en: What do you want?
Oh, I just thought... that was a strange dance...
rows.notes: Hokuto mistakes the martial-arts practice for a dance; trailing pause retained.

rows.en: It's not a dance! It's Shaolin kung fu, you idiot!
Sorry, sorry. ...But isn't calling me an idiot going a bit far?
I haven't seen you around. Who are you?
Oh, I'm... I just moved to Hoshimi Town.
Oh, Hokuto... Have you made a friend already?
Oh, Mom...
rows.notes: Address fragment retained.
Punctuation-only startled reaction retained.

rows.en: What's wrong, Mom?
...It's nothing. I've got something I need to do... so I'll go on ahead.
rows.notes: Orie gives a vague excuse rather than revealing her identity/mission.

rows.en: Huh? Go where?
You go straight home. ...You there, too.
rows.notes: The second instruction is also addressed to Ginga, who is still unnamed to Orie.

rows.en: Huh? Me? Why?
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing wrapper and terminal @ per brief.

rows.en: Just do as I say. Understood?
Mom...?
rows.notes: Address fragment retained.

rows.en: ...I don't get it. And who the heck are you, anyway?
Oh, sorry... I should've introduced myself sooner. I'm Hokuto... Hokuto Kusanagi.
Hokuto Kusanagi? That's a weird name.
rows.notes: English full-name order used for the phonetic repetition.

rows.en: ...And what's your name, then?
I'm Ginga Izumo. Ginga means galaxy. It's a great name, huh?
rows.notes: Ginga explains the meaning galaxy, preserving the name joke.

rows.en: Hmm... It's unusual.
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing wrapper and terminal @ per brief.

rows.en: What!? You're one to talk!
Is that an air raid siren...!?
Could it be the Giganos army!?
I-I can't just stand around here!
Hey, where are you going!? Ginga!!
Where else!? I'm going home! Home!!
Why are you following me all the way to my house!?
You're the one following me!
rows.notes: Context restores the reciprocal following-home accusation from row64.

rows.en: Oh, wait... Were you the one who moved in next door to us!?
You're my next-door neighbor!?
Forget that! Aren't Mom and Otome back from shopping yet!?
T-there's no one at my house, either...! Mom, where did you go...!?
L-look! Ginga!!
What's that!? I've never seen that robot before!!
I-it's attacking the town...!?
H-hey! It's coming this way!!
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. GEAR Fighter Dendoh is shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat-condition entry, not spoken dialogue.

rows.en: Gulfer Machine Beasts have landed in Hoshimi Town! They've begun attacking indiscriminately!
How is the evacuation of the residents going!?
It'll be complete soon!
rows.notes: It refers to the resident evacuation in row76.

rows.en: The Earth Federation Army's air squadron is still fighting. Losses stand at 49%.
It's only a matter of time before the other Machine Beasts get here!
Has Kirakuni still not boarded that thing!?
rows.notes: Shibuya asks HQ whether Kirakuni has boarded Dendoh; keep that thing as his deictic wording.

rows.en: He's currently making his way through Hoshimi Town's Third District!
rows.notes: Aiko reports Kirakuni location; Third District is the numbered neighborhood, not an added proper name.

rows.en: What on earth is he doing...!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: The Gulfer Machine Beasts' attack has cut off the roads, so he seems to be making his own way to the site.
rows.notes: Kirakuni is the subject established by Shibuya and the previous location report.

rows.en: I'm doing my best! Kirakuni is doing his best!
rows.notes: Kirakuni answers HQ, repeating his own surname in the source.

rows.en: We really should have built a secret underground route straight to the cockpit, like the Science Fortress Laboratory.
rows.notes: Inoue compares an emergency pilot access route with the Science Fortress Laboratory.

rows.en: There's no point saying that now.
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Aiko, how long until the Nahel Argama team arrives?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: About ten minutes.
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: We'll have to buy time somehow until they get here. ...What is Vega doing?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: She's heading to the site on the Valkyrie.
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Damn, how could this happen!? The Gulfer Machine Beasts are heading right for that place...!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Vega, hurry!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Yes, I know!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Those children are over there...! If the worst happens, I'll have to use that thing on my own...!
rows.notes: Vega thinks of the children and an emergency solo use of Dendoh; use restores the implied action while keeping the source vague. Source deliberately trails off.
uncertain: The source trails off after naming that thing; use is inferred from Dendoh boarding context, without asserting a specific operation.

rows.en: W-what!? That monster's coming right at us!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: N-no way!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: What!? Someone hasn't escaped yet!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Aaaaaah!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Daaaaamn it!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: What the hell is going on!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: You stuuuupid bastard!!
rows.notes: Ginga curses at the approaching threat; stretched insult retained.

rows.en: You stuuuupid bastard!!
rows.notes: Hokuto echoes the same stretched insult at the threat.

rows.en: W-what the hell!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: I-it activated! Dendoh did!
rows.notes: Inoue reports Dendoh activation, with the source afterthought retained.

rows.en: You did it, Kirakuni!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: No, there's no one in the cockpit!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: A-a-a rooobot!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: A mobile suit...!? No, that's not it!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: C-could it be something like Mazinger or Daimos!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Probably... But I've never seen a model like that before.
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: I-it moved!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Whoa! Aaaaaah!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: D-Dendoh...!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Let me go!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: You bastard!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: What!? Dendoh is taking those children!?
rows.notes: Kirakuni sees Dendoh collecting the children; question is alarm, not a completed cockpit report.

rows.en: Kirakuni, what's happened!? Answer me!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Children! There are two children in Dendoh's cockpit!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Children, you said!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: W-where are we...!? Ginga!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: You got dragged in too, Hokuto...?
rows.notes: Ginga addresses Hokuto hesitantly after both boys are taken aboard. Honorific dropped; hesitation retained without adding a request to confirm his name.

rows.en: W-we've been caught...
rows.notes: Hokuto describes both boys as captured; inclusive we restored.

rows.en: What should I do, Chief!? I missed my chance to board it...!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: How did that happen!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: ...Those children must have been chosen. By Dendoh, most likely...
rows.notes: Vega proposes that Dendoh chose the children, rather than stating it as certainty.

rows.en: Vega...!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: In any case, we'll just have to believe that for now.
rows.notes: Vega asks HQ to trust the explanation that Dendoh chose the boys.

rows.en: ...Give me a video feed from the cockpit. I'll talk to them from here.
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: All right.
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Damn it! Let me out!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: So this really is... a robot's cockpit?
rows.notes: Thought: Hokuto suspects their location is a robot cockpit.
Nonverbal exclamation retained exactly as ASCII punctuation.

rows.en: No! Of all people, why did it have to be that child!?
rows.notes: Vega recognizes Hokuto. That child stays deictic, without revealing the mother-son relationship.

rows.en: Aaaaaah! What the hell is this!? What's going ooon!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Calm down! Just calm down! At least we haven't been destroyed, even with those attacks...!
rows.notes: Hokuto tries to calm Ginga because the attacks have not destroyed them.

rows.en: So what!? Why the hell do I have to be stuck in here!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: I'm in the same boat! But screaming won't get us anywhere!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: If I don't scream, nobody's gonna come save us, are they!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: I said shut up! My head's already a mess as it is!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: You think you can figure this out just by thinking!? Idiot!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: You called me an idiot again! That's twice now!
rows.notes: The second insult refers back to their first meeting, original context row38.

rows.en: Oh, really? When did I say it? What year, month, day, hour, minute and second?
rows.notes: Childish exact-date retort retained with all time units.

rows.en: Just now, obviously! We only met today!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: You children in there!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Huh!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Who's there!? Can you see us!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Yes. Right now, you're inside... the cockpit of GEAR Fighter Dendoh.
rows.notes: Vega explains their cockpit location; full GEAR Fighter Dendoh form retained.

rows.en: Dendoh!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: So this really was... a cockpit...
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: I'm sure this is a shock to you, but it is to us, too.
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: But now that it's come to this, I'll need you two to do it.
rows.notes: Do it remains unresolved until the following demonstration, avoiding prematurely adding fight.

rows.en: Do what?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Both of you, stand up straight!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: On the count of three, put your right leg forward!
rows.notes: Both boys must extend the right leg on three; direction and count preserved.

rows.en: One, two, three!
rows.notes: Rhythm count, repeated in the route during the walking demonstration.

rows.en: One, two, three!
rows.notes: Rhythm count, repeated in the route during the walking demonstration.

rows.en: That's it! Keep going, alternating your left and right legs!
rows.notes: Vega continues the walking instructions, alternating legs.

rows.en: Dendoh is... walking...!
Whoa... That's all it takes to make it move...
What!?
I-it went right past...?
rows.notes: Dendoh walks past its intended enemy; restored Dendoh as it.

rows.en: Hey! Where are you going!?
Didn't you mean we should run away like this?
rows.notes: Ginga asks Vega whether her walking instructions meant to escape.

rows.en: Nooo! Dendoh is a warrior! What else would you do but fight that thing!?
Whaaat!?
Whaaat!?
You mean WE have to fight!?
Yes. There's something that looks like a game console in front of you, right?
There is, but...
Enter the code into that Gear Commander!
Press Drive A once, LR twice, LL once! ENTER! Then push it into the center of the front panel!
rows.notes: Kept all button labels and counts; it refers to the Gear Commander inserted into the panel.

rows.en: Got it! Hurry up, Ginga!
Uh, LL once... There!
Good!
Oh, I see! This is an installer!
rows.notes: Installer is the source term, clarified by the next explanation. Root confirmed source-literal hardware sense; not a software-installation program.

rows.en: Yes! That's right!
What's an installer...?
rows.notes: Question about Hokuto's term, with English subject and verb restored. Root confirmed source-literal hardware sense; not a software-installation program.

rows.en: It's a device that gives instructions to a computer.
Yes. You can use it to send instructions to the turbines in Dendoh's arms and legs.
A is for the arms, LL is for the left leg...
rows.notes: Preserves Vega's explanatory trailing-off before Hokuto interrupts.

rows.en: It's okay, I've got it now!
H-hey, Hokuto...
Ginga, that move! You know, the kung fu move you were doing earlier! Let's try it!
rows.notes: Hokuto asks Ginga to use the martial-arts move demonstrated earlier.

rows.en: What!?
Let's beat them! Otherwise, they'll destroy everyone! This town and everyone in it!
rows.notes: Threat targets the town and its residents; the source's emphatic fragments retained after a full subject and verb.

rows.en: We can do it! We'll be fine!
Yes, you'll be fine!
All riiight! Let's go!!
Y-you bastards! This was our chance, while that pest wasn't showing up...!!
rows.notes: The absent pest is the feared martial artist referenced again at240-246; no gender assigned.

rows.en: Ginga, let's go!!
Yeah! We're not letting you wreck any more of our town!!
Gulfer... At last, the time to fight has come! I'll protect those two and Dendoh, whatever it takes!
Gyandlar, the space crime syndicate! I won't let you do whatever you please to Earth!
Oho! Ain't that Grendizer!? So you were on this planet!
Perfect! If we nab the treasure from Planet Fleed, we'll score a whole lot of points!
rows.notes: Planet Fleed treasure is Grendizer; kept the indirect treasure description.

rows.en: This thing... It's definitely not a machine from Earth!
You've got some nerve comin' at us in that tiny little saucer!
An alien speaking Kansai dialect!? ...I've got a great story to bring back to Danbei!
Looks like this one's from outer space too!
Damn it! So we've got another invader on our hands!
Let's go, Hayato, Benkei! If we join our three hearts as one, there's nothing to fear!
rows.notes: Three hearts join as one; Devil Saturn 6 counters with six against three.

rows.en: Tough luck! We've got six hearts joined as one over here! Six against three, we win!
We'll smash anyone who gets in our way, no matter who they are!
Hey, wait! That's Kansai dialect! ...Which means...
rows.notes: Kaine recognizes Kansai dialect and sets up its stock business greeting.

rows.en: ...How's business treatin' ya?
rows.notes: Business greeting sets up the stock Kansai response; colloquial English makes the exchange audible.

rows.en: Eh, it's so-so!
rows.notes: Stock Kansai business-greeting response; restores business subject and preserves the so-so answer.

rows.en: This one's... the real deal!
These weirdos just keep coming, one after another!
We didn't come to this backwater 'cause we wanted to, either! Get that straight!
rows.notes: Request direction is the villain asking Judau to recognize their reluctant visit, not offering assistance.

rows.en: W-what! This one's a martial artist too!?
It seems a martial artist gave you quite a beating before. Then I'll give you a new memory to replace it!
rows.notes: Domon threatens to replace the memory of a prior martial-artist beating with his own.

rows.en: That getup of yours is damn misleading! I'm gonna finish you off!
rows.notes: Misleading appearance recalls the martial artist Devil Saturn 6 fears.

rows.en: Huh... So aliens speak Kansai dialect...
Ginga! This is no time to stand around gawking!
I know! More importantly, follow my kung fu moves!
Y-yeah!
W-what! This one uses Tenku Chushin Ken too!?
rows.notes: Uses glossary Tenku Chushin Ken; Ginga corrects the mistaken style next.

rows.en: Mine is Shaolin kung fu! Remember that, you clown of an alien!
rows.notes: Do-not-touch spelling Shaolin kung fu preserved.

rows.en: I knew it wasn't a Machine Beast... Could Gulfer have allies!?
rows.notes: Actual kind is thought; Vega contrasts Gyandlar with Gulfer Machine Beasts.

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'.

rows.en: Focus, #女愛称! Don't let the enemy overwhelm you! In real combat...
rows.notes: Male protagonist starts a real-combat maxim that the female protagonist interrupts; placeholders unchanged.

rows.en: In real combat, we might have to fight aliens speaking Kansai dialect!? I wasn't prepared for this!
rows.notes: Interrupts the maxim with an incredulous Kansai-speaking-alien question.

rows.en: ...True, I've never faced an opponent this weird before either...
You bastard! Don't talk about us like we're some kind of exotic beast!
rows.notes: Retains insult and the exotic-beast comparison.

rows.en: Phewww...
We made it somehow...
You both did very well!
The Federation air squadron's first attack has failed. Gulfer Machine Beasts have entered the Hoshimi Town area.
rows.notes: Meteo reports Federation attack failure and Gulfer entry; restored full report predicates.

rows.en: So the main force has arrived...!
This is the area where we picked up that energy reading.
Still, that big pointy thing... Oyakata-sama or Okayama-sama, whatever it's called...
rows.notes: Canonical glossary Oyakata-sama retained; Okayama-sama is deliberately misremembered. Complaint trails into235. Neutral it follows machine/AI glossary gender.
uncertain: Source sound-swap joke retained as Oyakata-sama/Okayama-sama; English humor transfer remains limited.

rows.en: What a slave driver! If you want somethin', go and get it yourself, I say!
rows.notes: Completes the complaint about the pointy object's leader; keeps slave-driver force.

rows.en: Well, though... It's stuck in the Moon, so I guess that ain't gonna happen.
rows.notes: Pointy entity is embedded in Moon; neutral it avoids unsupported gender.

rows.en: W-what!?
It's not Gulfer... Who in the world are they!?
rows.notes: Vega addresses the newcomers, not an identification of Gulfer.

rows.en: Are they enemies too!?
rows.notes: Newly arriving enemies; original following rows settle they are Devil Saturn 6.

rows.en: Gah! I-is that Kenryuu!? What's it doing here!?
They seem surprised to see us, don't they?
Tch! Well, that makes two of us!
Huh? Hmmm? Wait, that's something else if you look closely!
Sheesh, you gave me a scare! I thought that pest had shown up!
rows.notes: Fearful mistaken recognition of Kenryuu continues; gender-neutral pest avoids unsourced pronoun and draft added idiot.

rows.en: Ah... No, no! Speak of the bald... I mean, devil!
rows.notes: Adapts the source bald/shadow malapropism to bald/devil, preserving the mistaken word and self-correction.
uncertain: Pun transcreated: bald/shadow in Japanese becomes bald/devil in English.

rows.en: If that idiot really showed up, it wouldn't be funny!
Besides, if we do the same routine as last time, people'll get bored!
rows.notes: Fourth-wall aside to the audience; same-routine callback kept without inventing a prior event.

rows.en: What's that? You've seen this plot before?
rows.notes: Fourth-wall question addressed to the audience.

rows.en: I'm begging you, don't say that!
rows.notes: Speaker requests audience silence; request direction preserved.

rows.en: What's that thing doing...?
rows.notes: Gender-neutral thing refers to the unknown robot Devil Saturn 6; no gender inferred.

rows.en: All right, here we go!
I'm taking that treasure and the Commander Ranking for myself!!
rows.notes: Commander Ranking capitalization follows the approved campaign convention confirmed by root.

rows.en: They're coming, you two!!
We have to fight them too!? Us!?
Yes! What are you talking about!?
N-no way...!
Nobody told me about this!
How do you expect us to take on that many!?
Missiles, beams, swords, bows, yo-yos...!
rows.notes: Weapon-list fragment continues into row260.

rows.en: Boomerangs, chainsaws, blue feathers... Don't we have any weapons!?
We don't...!
At least, we don't right now...!
rows.notes: Thought retains deliberate qualification trailing off.

rows.en: But now I don't have a choice.
Install the SP1 command in your Gear Commanders!
rows.notes: SP1 preserved as the exact source code label; no expansion invented.

rows.en: Got it!
All riiight!!
SP1! Command, instaaall!!
rows.notes: SP1 preserved as the exact source code label; no expansion invented.

rows.en: SP1! Command, instaaall!!
rows.notes: SP1 preserved as the exact source code label; no expansion invented.

rows.en: The Nahel Argama team is entering Hoshimi Town's airspace.
Oh, you've come to help us!
Who are those guys?
They don't look like weapons from Earth.
Yeah...
Wait! Could that Gundam be...
rows.notes: Unfinished recognition continues through Ginga's next two rows.

rows.en: I-I know it too! In the finals of the Colony Martial Arts Championship two tournaments ago...
rows.notes: Sentence deliberately breaks across rows275-276; two tournaments ago is not the previous championship. Championship name is a source-literal compound; no canonical Akurasu entry established.

rows.en: It's piloted by the guy who had that amazing fight with Kazuya Ryuzaki, right!?
You sure know a lot about that sort of thing.
Yeah! Anyone who does martial arts would know that!
So even they have finally come to Earth...
rows.notes: They refers to the arriving alien enemies, not the allied reinforcements.

rows.en: 1. GEAR Fighter Dendoh is shot down@2. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Plain loss conditions; one @ retained.

rows.en: Good. We've held them off for now...
Whew! We did it, Hokuto!
Yeah...
What!? D-Dendoh's...!?
rows.notes: Deliberately incomplete surprise at Dendoh's failure.

rows.en: W-what is it this time!?
This is bad! Dendoh's energy...!!
rows.notes: Deliberately incomplete alarm about energy, settled by row289 standby-battery explanation.

rows.en: I-it's falling over!?
rows.notes: Dendoh itself is falling over, as confirmed by standby-battery failure in289; no pilot subject substituted.

rows.en: Oh no!
I'd only equipped Dendoh with standby energy batteries!
rows.notes: Vega admits her own equipment oversight; standby-only battery detail retained.

rows.en: Aiko, activate the capture beacon! Hurry!
rows.notes: Capture beacon is a source-literal technical compound; no canonical Akurasu entry established.

rows.en: Roger. Activating the capture beacon!
rows.notes: Capture beacon is a source-literal technical compound; no canonical Akurasu entry established.

rows.en: Lord Gandal, that giant fortress appears to have landed on the opposite side of the Moon from us.
Put the image on the monitor.
There's no doubt. That's...
rows.notes: Recognition trails off before Barendos identifies Spiral Castle.

rows.en: Yes, it's their Spiral Castle.
Gulfer, the enemy of our Vegan Empire... No, of every living thing in the universe... Now they're after Earth.
Hmph. What a troublesome bunch to turn up. ...So, what are they doing?
They immediately sent a swarm of Machine Beasts to Earth, but...
rows.notes: Report trails off before row299 supplies repulsion.

rows.en: Duke Fleed and the others seem to have driven them off. They haven't made any move against us, either.
Of course. Even they couldn't see through Skull Moon's special shield.
Yes... We'll watch and wait for a while.
...And that's what happened.
So, in short, the Earthlings defeated you, and you came running back here?
W-well, yeah, that's about the size of it.
You're pathetic. You've brought shame on us Gyandlar.
S-sorry, Big Sis Diondra!
rows.notes: Big Sis address intentionally provokes row307 correction.

rows.en: Don't call me Big Sis! Call me Lady Diondra!
We brought you Gyandlar under our command on His Majesty's orders... But you're nothing but a hindrance.
rows.notes: Giga Witter asserts command over Gyandlar; Diondra disputes it in309-310.

rows.en: Under your command? Don't make me laugh.
We're your partners. If Gades, our Gyandlar boss, hadn't ordered us here, who'd come to a place like this?
rows.notes: Rhetorical question carries refusal to come except on Gades's orders.

rows.en: But you seek the same thing we do... The Data Weapons, correct?
That's right. But don't you dare forget the agreement between your emperor and Gades.
Hmph... What right does a mere band of space criminals have to talk?
...Enough of this pointless bickering.
Yes... Oyakata-sama.
rows.notes: Fixed glossary title Oyakata-sama retained.

rows.en: Dendoh is the problem. I never imagined it would be on that planet...
Dendoh... The other lost Gear that our Machine Empire Gulfer has been searching for...
rows.notes: Source noun phrase identifying Dendoh retains deliberate fragment.

rows.en: If it's on Earth, then the Data Weapons must be...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished conditional: row319 confirms the inferred Data Weapon presence.

rows.en: Indeed. The Data Weapons are with the Gears...
rows.notes: Gears plural follows the class of machines rather than just Dendoh.

rows.en: But Dendoh and the Earthlings seem not to have acquired those electronic sacred beasts yet...
rows.notes: Electronic sacred beasts describes the Data Weapons from the preceding exchange.

rows.en: This is our chance... Suspend humanity's annihilation on Earth. We will focus all our efforts on finding the Data Weapons.
rows.notes: Measured draft overflow (4 lines:334/347/335/129 px). Tightened the rare-opportunity opening and operation wording; kept the subject/predicate, suspension of annihilation on Earth, and all efforts devoted to searching.

rows.en: Yes... His Imperial Majesty also wishes to acquire them.
My three Machine Generals, Giga Absolute, Giga Witter and Giga Gourmet...
rows.notes: Formal summons of all three Machine Generals; deliberate vocative fragment.

rows.en: Send your Chips to Earth at once to search for the Data Weapons...
Yes, my lord. We will give them the same appearance as Earthlings.
Come forth, my other selves...
Hm? Do Earthlings look the same as the people of Alktos, too?
rows.notes: Alktos spelling from Planet Alktos glossary entry; no gender assigned to Chips.

rows.en: It certainly looks that way.
rows.notes: Removed source trailing wrapper artifact; Chip speech quirk rendered as conversational emphasis.

rows.en: Anyway, what are we supposed to do?
Go forth, my other selves...
And find clues to the Data Weapons...
Report everything you see to us, one detail at a time...
Roger that!
We'll stake the pride of the three Machine Generals on it!
rows.notes: Restored promise predicate; source vow invokes the three Machine Generals pride.

rows.en: Just leave it to us!
rows.notes: Offering help to the generals; leave it to us is the correct request direction.

rows.en: ...Heh heh heh. It seems we can't afford to sit around either...
...Welcome to GEAR headquarters. I'm Shibuya, the chief here.
Captain Bright Noa, captain of the Nahel Argama, reporting, sir.
rows.notes: Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank [jp] to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: First, allow me to thank you. Thanks to your arrival as reinforcements, we somehow managed to drive them off.
There's no need to thank us... I'd like to hear what you have to say.
rows.notes: Meaning correction: replaced added duty explanation with polite refusal of thanks; hearing Shibuya explanation is the original request.

rows.en: I understand. I'm sure those children have questions as well.
rows.notes: Those children are Hokuto and Ginga, brought in at343.

rows.en: Those children?
Chief Shibuya, I've brought Dendoh's two pilots.
Thank you for your work.
...Wh-where... are we?
How should I know? I don't know either.
! Could they be the pilots of that blue super robot...?
rows.notes: Elliptical question retains tentative trailing ending; pilots restored from next response.

rows.en: Yes... Would you both tell us your names?
I'm Hokuto... Kusanagi.
rows.notes: Source family name followed by given name reordered naturally, retaining hesitation. Removed trailing wrapper artifact.

rows.en: Ginga Izumo...
rows.notes: Self-introduction remains a deliberate name-only utterance.

rows.en: Hokuto and Ginga, then. Thank you for coming to GEAR headquarters.
GEAR? What's that?
GEAR is a secret defense organization formed to protect Earth from Gulfer.
Gulfer... Do you mean the ones we fought?
Yes... They're a fearsome machine empire plotting to annihilate all life in the universe... And GEAR's foremost enemy.
rows.notes: Restored explicit they are predicate for machine-empire identification; source descriptive noun structure is not retained as an English subject omission.

rows.en: A m-machine empire...!?
Then, that Dendoh...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing question about Dendoh, answered at358.

rows.en: It's a robot built to fight them... GEAR's trump card.
Wh-why do we have to ride in something like that!?
Well, that's...
rows.notes: Chief Shibuya begins explaining but Vega takes over.

rows.en: Chief, I'll take over the explanation from here.
Th-that voice... Could you be...?
You're the lady who contacted us earlier!?
That's right, Ginga. And... Hokuto.
rows.notes: Pause before addressing Hokuto hints at concealed family relationship; honorifics dropped. Meaning correction: removed invented dear; kept hesitant address to Hokuto with honorific dropped. English pause placement conveys hesitation without revealing concealed relationship.

rows.en: What is it...? Her voice sounds like Mom's...
rows.notes: Thought; glossary confirms Vega is Hokuto mother; no added identity reveal.

rows.en: W-wait, could it be...?
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing suspicion; joke is resolved by369.

rows.en: Wh-what?
Are you copying Char, the Red Comet, with that mask?
rows.notes: Char joke refers to Vega mask, not a claim that Vega is Char. Clarified source action as copying Char mask appearance; no new content, natural spoken interrogative.

rows.en: Huh!?
I see. Now that he mentions it, she does...
rows.notes: Thought; Bright sees the mask resemblance after Ginga points it out.

rows.en: N-no, it isn't. This is a visor I need for my duties.
Huh... So, who are you, anyway?
My name is Vega... I'm GEAR's deputy commander.
Hokuto, Ginga... You have your Gear Commanders with you, don't you?
Y-yes.
Then try touching your Gear Commanders together.
L-like this?
Th-they lit up!?
Wh-what's this light!?
Amazing...! It's completely different from when the deputy commander and I tried it...
rows.notes: I is Kirakuni; earlier attempt was Kirakuni together with Vega.

rows.en: Only those who can make those two Gear Commanders shine can pilot Dendoh.
And the brighter they shine, the more powerful Dendoh becomes.
Then that means we're...
rows.notes: Deliberate sentence fragment completed by Vega385.

rows.en: Yes... You're the true pilots chosen by Dendoh.
Wh-why!? I've never piloted a robot in my life!
N-neither have I...
rows.notes: Reply means Hokuto has also never piloted a robot; predicate restored.

rows.en: So why us!?
We don't know either. Only Dendoh knows why you two were chosen...
And... We need you two to bring out Dendoh's full potential and protect this Earth from Gulfer.

rows.notes: Silent reaction preserved.

rows.en: Listen carefully, both of you. For Earth's sake... No, for the sake of the whole universe, we absolutely need your help.
O-our help...?
rows.notes: Echoes Chief Shibuya request and trails off in disbelief.

rows.en: What do you want us to do...?
...Fight Gulfer. Alongside us... and Dendoh.
What!?
Us!?
W-we can't possibly fight them!

rows.notes: Chief Shibuya silence preserved.

rows.en: So we need Dendoh and those boys to fight Gulfer...
rows.notes: Bright privately considers the recruitment; thought kind retained.

rows.en: We need their strength, too... They're still so young, just like Judau, Ple and the others...
rows.notes: Thought continues Bright's concern; unfinished trailing reflection retained.

rows.en: You've got other powerful robots besides Dendoh, right!? So why do we have to fight!?
What even is Gulfer, anyway!? Why are they attacking Earth!?
As the chief said earlier... Gulfer is a machine empire. In other words, a group of living, mechanical life-forms.
And once they set their sights on a planet, they never give up...
That's right... Gulfer has already destroyed many planets.
And they're growing even stronger with help from Gyandlar, a space crime syndicate of fellow mechanical life-forms...
rows.notes: Gyandlar consists of mechanical life-forms too; its support strengthens Gulfer.

rows.en: What's more, Gulfer's advance forces have built a fortress on the Moon, and they're targeting Earth.

rows.notes: Silence; stray source closing wrapper and indentation discarded.

rows.en: It's impossible! There's just no way! We can't do anything like that!
Hokuto...
rows.notes: Vega privately addresses Hokuto by name; thought kind retained; hidden identity stays hidden.

rows.en: We're just ordinary elementary school kids! How are we supposed to fight a machine empire!?

rows.notes: Deliberate lead-in fragment, completed by the separate following row.

rows.en: We beat them just now, didn't we?
But I don't think we can ever do that again!
Yeah? I think we can.

rows.notes: Wordless startled reaction retained.

rows.en: I dunno how it happened, but we were chosen, right?
Then doesn't that mean we can do it?
rows.notes: It means fighting Gulfer as chosen Dendoh pilots; conversational reference to previous row retained.

rows.en: Do what!?
We won't know unless we try, will we!?
I don't know!
rows.notes: Hokuto rejects Ginga's try-it-and-see argument; full subject and verb retained.

rows.en: Quit your whining! Are you even a boy!?
rows.notes: Gender taunt preserved at source strength; not softened.

rows.en: Of course I'm a boy! But you don't understand how hard fighting is!
I do understand! But we can't just leave it alone! How can we be the only ones to turn a blind eye!?
That's exactly why you...!!
rows.notes: Argument deliberately interrupted by Vega; trailing clause retained.

rows.en: Oh, for crying out loud! That's enough!!

rows.notes: Wordless startled reaction retained.
Wordless startled reaction retained.

rows.en: You've done nothing but yell, yell, yell! Boys shouldn't make such a racket!!
rows.notes: Vega loses her composure scolding both boys; repetition and gendered rebuke retained.

rows.en: V-Vega...
rows.notes: Shibuya hesitantly interrupts Vega; vocative fragment retained.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: Ah... I-I'm sorry...
Th-that scared me...
rows.notes: Kirakuni's private thought, startled by Vega's outburst.

rows.en: ...Hokuto, I understand what you're saying...
But Dendoh chose you, and everyone needs its power. Those are things we know for certain.
rows.notes: Its power refers to Dendoh, which needs both pilots; subject restored.

rows.en: And you too, Ginga... Even though Dendoh chose you, that doesn't make fighting any easier.
rows.notes: Vega addresses Ginga after acknowledging Hokuto's fear; choosing does not remove hardship.

rows.en: ...Please remember that.
Now all we can do is let the two of you decide for yourselves...
rows.notes: Decision belongs to both boys, not the officers.

rows.en: Ginga, Hokuto...
rows.notes: Vocative pause addressing both boys retained.

rows.en: ...We really do have to do this, huh?
Hey... If we don't fight, they'll destroy our town and hurt everyone, you know?
But...
rows.notes: Hokuto's hesitant objection deliberately trails off.

rows.en: My mom told me, "Justice without power is powerless. Power without justice is violence..."
rows.notes: Ginga quotes his mother's two-part maxim; both power/justice contrasts retained.

rows.en: We've got this power, after all... Let's try using it for justice!
Hokuto, have faith. In yourself, and in Dendoh, which chose you...
rows.notes: Faith directive targets Hokuto, himself and the Dendoh that selected him.

rows.en: ...All right. I'll pilot Dendoh.
To protect Dad, Mom and everyone else from Gulfer...!
rows.notes: Purpose fragment continues Hokuto's complete commitment in447, not a lost predicate.

rows.en: All right! It's settled!
Thank you, Ginga, Hokuto.
I'll be counting on you from now on.
rows.notes: Kirakuni asks for the boys' cooperation; request direction preserved as I'll be counting on you.

rows.en: Yeah!
Now, Captain Bright... There's something I'd like to ask of you.
rows.notes: Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank [jp] to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: What is it?
You'll be continuing your patrol duties in the Japan sector, correct?
Yes, sir.
rows.notes: Reply to Misumaru confirming the fleet rendezvous.

rows.en: Then I'd like you to take Hokuto, Ginga... and Dendoh into the Nahel Argama unit.
rows.notes: Shibuya requests that Bright add both pilots and Dendoh to the Nahel Argama unit.

rows.en: They need to get used to Dendoh as quickly as possible.
...Are you sure that's all right with you?
rows.notes: Bright checks whether sending Dendoh away is acceptable to GEAR.

rows.en: Yes... Gulfer isn't our only enemy. This arrangement will let us respond more flexibly to whatever happens.
Does that mean... we'll have to fight other humans, too...?
rows.notes: Other humans contrasts human enemies with the mechanical Gulfer.

rows.en: Yes. Many organizations plan to exploit the current turmoil and conquer Earth by force...
Like Gulfer, they too threaten the peace of the Earth Sphere...
B-but...
rows.notes: Hokuto's objection deliberately trails off.

rows.en: ...Modern mobile weapons have highly effective escape systems.
So as long as you don't hit the cockpit directly, you can avoid hurting the person inside.
rows.notes: Avoid direct cockpit hits to spare the pilot; source assurance retained without adding a guarantee of no casualties.

rows.en: ...Remember that.
rows.notes: Stray source closing wrapper and indentation discarded.

rows.en: ...Yes.
Now, Dr. Inoue... Have Dendoh brought aboard the Nahel Argama.
Understood. Ginga, Hokuto, please go ahead to the Nahel Argama.
rows.notes: The boys go ahead; Inoue will arrange bringing Dendoh aboard.

rows.en: Yeah, got it.
Chief Shibuya, those children...
rows.notes: Bright's concern about the children trails off; Shibuya answers in472.

rows.en: I know. My conscience troubles me, too, when I think of sending children into battle...
But now that Dendoh has chosen them... they cannot avoid fighting.
rows.notes: Being selected makes them targets, explained in475-476; no invented compulsion mechanic.

rows.en: What do you mean?
Gulfer is certain to come after Dendoh and those boys.
And if they should fall into Gulfer's hands... it would mean the death of every living thing in the galaxy.
rows.notes: They refers to Dendoh and the two pilots, not Gulfer; galaxy means Milky Way here.

rows.en: The entire galaxy...? Just what kind of secret does Dendoh hold...?
rows.notes: Bright repeats galaxy then asks about Dendoh's secret; trailing question retained.

rows.en: I'll tell you when the time comes. For that reason, I'd like to come aboard with the boys as well.
rows.notes: Vega asks to accompany the boys aboard; does not reveal her identity or the secret.

rows.en: ...Understood.
Huh, so this is Dendoh.
It's a little unusual for an Earth-made super robot. Those turbines on both its arms and legs, for instance...
rows.notes: Earth-made qualification is the speaker's assumption; not stated as narrator fact. Arms/legs turbines kept.

rows.en: Yeah. From the way it fought earlier, it looks like a robot built mainly for hand-to-hand combat, like a Mobile Fighter.
Yeah. Its moves were pretty good.
It probably has controls similar to the Mobile Trace System.
rows.notes: Rain infers a similar control device; no assertion of identical system.

rows.en: And... From what I hear, its pilots are about the same age as Ple and Ple Two.
What!? Is that really true?
U-um!!
rows.notes: Nervous attention-getting interjection.

rows.en: Oh... Could you be Dendoh's pilot?
Y-yes! I'm Ginga Izumo!!
Ginga, what's wrong? You're all tense...
I-I-I'm nervous! Th-the King of Hearts is standing right in front of me!!
rows.notes: Repeated stutter and enthusiastic nervousness in front of hero preserved.

rows.en: Hee hee, so Domon's the one you wanted to see.
...What do you want?

rows.notes: Stutter chosen as S to preserve sweeping/sign callback through497.

rows.en: S-s-s?
rows.notes: Kaine echoes the stutter without inventing a word.

rows.en: Are you offering to sweep the place or something?
rows.notes: Cleaning joke kept as sweeping matching S stutter.

rows.en: S-sign an autograph for me, please!! I'm a fan of yours, Domon!
rows.notes: Sign phrasing transcreates source autograph stutter to preserve cleaning joke sound callback.

rows.en: So please, I want the King of Hearts' autograph!!
rows.notes: Explicit asking for autograph, not offering own autograph.

rows.en: Domon, give him one. We're going to be together from now on.
rows.notes: Rain asks Domon to sign for Ginga because they will be comrades.

rows.en: Then there's no need.
If you're a martial artist too, you should understand. My emblem... The King of Hearts is already engraved on your heart.
rows.notes: Domon's literal emblem metaphor; no actual signature granted.

rows.en: ...As proof that we're comrades who will fight together.
rows.notes: Deliberate appended phrase explaining the metaphor in502.

rows.en: Y-you're pretty corny. I wouldn't have guessed it.
Nah... That's just how he is, isn't it?
S-so... So cool...!
I'm sorry, Ginga. He's just embarrassed. He's not used to signing autographs.
rows.notes: Domon's embarrassment and lack of autograph practice restored explicitly.

rows.en: Embarrassed? That's what that is?
Y-you can really tell that...?
Yes. We've known each other a long time.
So that's what makes them the best partners... #男愛称 and I probably couldn't pull that off.
rows.notes: Reflects on Rain/Domon as best partners and doubts own pairing with male protagonist. Both placeholders preserved.

rows.en: Hokuto, Ginga... I'm sorry I'm late.
Oh, Dr. Inoue... And Aiko.
Sorry. Loading the Hyper Dendoh Batteries took longer than we expected.
rows.notes: Fixed Hyper Dendoh Batteries term; no battery pun expansion.

rows.en: Batteries... You mean actual batteries?
Yes. Once we equip it with proper Hyper Dendoh Batteries...
rows.notes: Conditional begins here and resolves517.

rows.en: You won't need to worry about running out of energy like you did today.
What!? Dendoh runs on batteries!?
D-don't robots these days run on solar energy or something!?
We considered that too... But cloudy and rainy days would be a problem.
And nighttime, too.
Wouldn't it be fine if you could deal with the hassle and time it takes to recharge?
But... Humanoid mobile weapons need more energy than you'd think.
Even the batteries for #機体名's auxiliary power run out in no time...
rows.notes: Unit placeholder expands to128px; no replacement with a specific unit.

rows.en: For now, we can manage with Dendoh as it is.
As it is now... What does he mean by that...?
rows.notes: Thought asks about Dr. Inoue's as-it-is qualification.

rows.en: Hokuto, Ginga... Shall we get going?
Yes, Kirakuni.
Where are you going?
We're going to live aboard this ship starting today... So we have to explain that to our moms.
rows.notes: We/our moms covers both boys going to their families; boarding arrangement explicit.

rows.en: Though we'll keep the fact that they're Dendoh's pilots a secret.
rows.notes: Pilot identity concealed from parents and enemy; actual role not revealed by Kirakuni.

rows.en: Right... It'd be bad if Gulfer or someone found out.
Then go get your mom to spoil you rotten.
Yeah, be good to your parents while you can still see them. Otherwise, you'll regret it.
rows.notes: Kaine's advice reflects his missing mother, clarified537-538.

rows.en: Huh?
Kaine, could your mother be...?
rows.notes: Question intentionally trails off before537 explains mother missing.

rows.en: ...She went missing during the war with Giganos.
Oh... But don't worry about it. My mom's a tough one. I'm sure she's all right.
A tough one... Then your mom's like mine.
rows.notes: My situation matches yours, meaning both mothers are strong-willed; no inference that Ginga's mother is missing.

rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.notes: Stray source closing wrapper ignored per brief.

rows.en: ...You'll find out soon enough.
rows.notes: Points forward to Midori's angry response552-559.

rows.en: ...And this is the hangar.
Wow...
Oh, they've already brought Dendoh aboard.
The hatch on its back seems to be open. What's that for?
I-I don't know... What could it be?
Looks like the kids have already made friends. They're close in age, after all.
Yeah.
rows.notes: Stray source closing wrapper ignored per brief.

rows.en: Those boys are Dendoh's pilots...
They say Akira Hibiki, Raideen's pilot, is only in middle school too... And he'll be joining us soon.
rows.notes: Raideen pilot Akira is arriving soon, and is middle-school age.

rows.en: Could it be that we won't get any more pilots around my age...?
rows.notes: Speaker worries about lack of pilots of own age; no new arrivals asserted as fact.

rows.en: Th-the Federation Army...? You're with them?
Yes, well...
Hey, Gin!!
rows.notes: Gin is Midori's source nickname for Ginga; kept as nickname rather than rewritten full name.

rows.en: Here we go!
rows.notes: Thought anticipates mother's scolding; callback to541.

rows.en: You've finally gotten yourself into trouble with the Federation Army, not just the police!!
rows.notes: Mother assumes trouble severe enough for military, escalating beyond police.

rows.en: Who did you pick a fight with this time!? I've told you over and over, Shaolin kung fu isn't for that sort of thing...!
rows.notes: Mother's warning trails off; Shaolin kung fu fixed glossary form, even though Japanese calls Shorinji Kempo.

rows.en: I'm telling you, I didn't get into any fights!
Don't lie to me! Then why would a Federation soldier come to our house!?
rows.notes: Mother demands explanation for military visitor, answered in following packet.

rows.en: Th-that's what I'm trying to tell you! Just listen to Kirakuni!
rows.notes: Ginga asks Midori to listen to Kirakuni instead of accusing him of fighting.

rows.en: N-now I see... So this is what Ginga meant earlier.
rows.notes: Thought; callback to Ginga539-541 saying Hokuto would soon understand how strong-willed his mother was.

rows.en: Come on, own up to it! What on earth have you done!?
Um, Mrs. Izumo. I don't think it's anything like that. Isn't that right?
rows.notes: Orie addresses Midori by family name and seeks Kirakuni confirmation.

rows.en: Y-yes! Ginga and Hokuto have been selected as junior science trainees by our public relations department.
rows.notes: Cover story established at531: children identities as Dendoh pilots stay secret; science trainee is generic program wording, not added actual mission.

rows.en: Trainees...!?
Yes. The purpose of the training tour is to visit various research facilities and let them experience the latest science and technology.
A tour...?
They'll have to be away from elementary school, but it will count as attending class.
...There won't be anything dangerous, will there?
Well, that's...
rows.notes: Kirakuni stalls rather than reassuring Midori that real combat is safe.

rows.en: M-Mom! I wanna go on that tour! It's such a great chance, since they picked me!
rows.notes: Meaning correction: removed invented effort on the selectors part; source stresses the chance of having been selected.

rows.en: ...It's suspicious to see you get so excited about studying... Don't you think?
Sh-she's sharp...
rows.notes: Thought; Midori has noticed Ginga unusual enthusiasm for study.

rows.en: N-no, it's not! I can get motivated too, you know!
...All right. If you want to go, I won't stop you.
Kirakuni, please take good care of my son. If he gets up to anything, don't hesitate to scold him.
rows.notes: Request direction: mother asks Kirakuni to look after her son, and permits scolding.

rows.en: Y-yes, ma'am.
I feel like I'm the one who's going to get scolded...
rows.notes: Thought; Kirakuni fears Midori will scold him.

rows.en: Hokuto, what are you going to do?
Yeah... I'll go too. Ginga will be with me, after all.
I see... All right, then.
Then I'll come to pick them up tomorrow... Please excuse me.
Gin! Are you going somewhere?
rows.notes: Gin is Ginga source nickname used by mother and younger sister; kinship expressed naturally by sibling context.

rows.en: Yeah... I'm going on a trip for a little while. You be good, okay?
rows.notes: Ginga refers to himself as big brother in Japanese; restored first-person I in English.

rows.en: If I'm good, will you bring me back a present?
Sure. What would you like?
Um... um... Hmm... A stuffed lion!
You got it. I'll bring you one for sure.
Yay!
If you're going to be away for a while, I'll make your favorite food for dinner tonight.
What's wrong, Gin? Is your stomach upset?
N-no, it's just...
You're such a strange boy.
I'm sorry, Mom. I lied to you...
rows.notes: Thought; apology is inward, mother does not hear it.

rows.en: But... I'm going so I can protect you, Otome and everyone else, Mom...
rows.notes: Thought; Ginga resolves to go fight in order to protect Mom, Otome and others.

rows.en: Well, Mrs. Izumo... We should be on our way too.
I'm sorry I couldn't offer you much hospitality...
rows.notes: Host apologizes for not entertaining guests properly; apology predicate restored.

rows.en: Not at all. Besides, starting tomorrow, Hokuto will be relying on your Ginga.
rows.notes: Request/help direction: Hokuto will receive Ginga help, not the other way around.

rows.en: Gin will be relying on Hokuto too... Please look after him, Hokuto.
rows.notes: Midori reciprocates Orie599 and asks Hokuto to look after Gin; resolved son referent in reciprocal sentence. Meaning correction: replaced ambiguous reciprocal auxiliary with explicit Gin relying on Hokuto, resolving reversed help direction from599.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Removed trailing source wrapper artifact.

rows.en: See ya, Hokuto!
Yeah, see you tomorrow.
He's the boy you met at school, right? He's so lively. He seems like a nice boy.
rows.notes: Orie and Hokuto have left; he is Ginga, known from school.

rows.en: Yeah... We might become good friends.
So... Are you really going on that tour, Hokuto?
Mom... Why are you asking me that?
Well, you can never say no when someone asks you to do something, can you?
So I wondered if you were unable to turn down this trainee business too...
rows.notes: Orie wonders whether Hokuto only agreed because he could not say no.

rows.en: ...I'm still a little unsure, but Ginga will be with me. And besides...
rows.notes: Hokuto sentence intentionally trails off before additional reason.

rows.en: Besides what?
rows.notes: Follow-up question restores what predicate rather than retaining bare fragment; source wrapper artifact removed.

rows.en: I feel like I have to go. I can't really explain it, though...
I see... If you've made up your mind, I won't say anything more.
But don't forget. I'm always thinking of you...
rows.notes: Orie assures Hokuto she is always thinking of him; no extra warning added.

rows.en: Then let's have your favorite for dinner tonight too.
rows.notes: Source trailing wrapper artifact removed.

rows.en: I'll put my heart and soul into making you some stew.
Yay! Your stew's the best, Mom!
rows.notes: Ordinary mother stew praise, not system-part item label Mom Stew.
